svg.title: Phil AI behavior tree, full structure
svg.desc: The root points to a selector with three condition-gated branches based on AI state. Chasing leads to a Chase and attack sequence: find player, move to player with a 10 second limit, set an attack flag, then a nested Attack state sequence that melee attacks, waits, finds the player again, and checks range, looping back to itself while an isAttack flag is set. Patrolling leads to a Wandering sequence: pick a random spot, move there, wait. Stunned leads directly to a single Get stunned task.
